summary: Both printed pages closely match the official 2018 v5 PDF; needs a small form-local tweak for Page 2 Item 63 specify text padding, plus shared print fixes for comb tick collisions and >8-digit comb overflow.

defects.where: Page 1 Item 9 Registered Address and Page 2 Part V Item 70 Spouse's Name
defects.what: Long address and spouse name overflow their comb boxes and collide directly with the comb tick marks.

defects.where: Page 1 Part II Items 21, 22, 24-30 and Page 2 Part IV.A Items 38-40, 44-45, IV.C Items 64-65
defects.what: Large or negative computed amounts exceeding 8 comb slots print blank.

defects.where: Page 2, Part IV.C Item 63 (Other Tax Credits/Payments specify)
defects.what: Long specify text runs flush against the right border of the specify box with no right padding.

defects.where: Page 2, bottom reference tables (Table 1 and Table 2 Tax Rates)
defects.what: Reference tax rate tables are moved out of the filed sheet into guide.html per provenance.json.

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print (owned by neon-4 on try/forms-shared-print): mask comb ticks under overflowing long names/addresses (Items 9, 70) and handle >8-digit/negative comb overflow in Part II/IV.
open_questions: Print preview window opens natively on Linux via WebKitGTK; full unclipped 1400px-wide print-p*.png pages were rendered from the running app's generated sheet.html via headless Chrome --print-to-pdf + pypdfium2.
